sources.note: Nothing. The words stress/accent/tone/syllable do not occur; sec. 2.1.4 (p. 10) says the 120-item SIL-PNG wordlist (Mamgak, Feb 2020) was 'transcribed using the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA)'; Appendix D Table 37 (pp. 55-64) Forak (Mamgak) column has no stress marks anywhere (0 occurrences of the IPA stress sign in the report), e.g. takmamnɘ 'his head', tikmut 'nose', dabai 'eye', baifɘʔ 'belly'. sources.citation: Carter, John, Katie Carter, John Grummitt, Bonnie MacKenzie & Janell Masters. 2012. A sociolinguistic survey of the Mur village vernaculars. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2012-043. Dallas: SIL International. 90 pp.
sources.note: Nothing for Forak. Forak appears only as a comparison wordlist: pp. 19-20 lexicostatistics (Molet-Forak 28-30%); appendix 40-item ASJP table (printed pp. 49-50 ff.), Forak column = Mamgak/Sariŋ, elicitor Mike Sweeney, 18-Oct-95, IPA without stress marks (yɨwɨt 'bird', tikmut 'nose', manai 'name'). Cites Brownie, Hayward & Sweeney 1995 (unpublished).
